def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seqs=[]
    for r in (0,h-1):
        row=grid[r]; c=0
        while c<w:
            if row[c]!=0:
                s=c
                while c<w and row[c]!=0: c+=1
                seqs.append(list(row[s:c]))
            else: c+=1
    shift=0
    for r in range(1,h-1):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            seq=next((s for s in seqs if v in s),None)
            if seq is None: continue
            i=seq.index(v)
            start=c-i+shift
            if start<0:
                shift+=1
                start=0
                seg=seq[-(c-i+shift):] if c-i+shift>0 else seq
                # clip left: drop first (-origstart) elements
                drop=-(c-i)  # positive
                seg=seq[drop:]
                for k,x in enumerate(seg):
                    if start+k<w: out[r][start+k]=x
            else:
                for k,x in enumerate(seq):
                    if start+k<w: out[r][start+k]=x
    return out

ok=all(transform(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in pairs)
print('all demos match:', ok)
